content:
BUILT CoLAB would like to invite you to the Conference "The Revolution of Digital Construction in Portugal", the closing event of the mobilising project REV@CONSTRUCTION in which we take part.

📅 Tuesday, 27 June | ⏰2:00pm

📌 Mariano Gago Auditorium – Pavilhão do Conhecimento | Lisbon

This Conference aims to present the main progress the project has made towards Digital Construction in Portugal and to discuss its advantages for the future of the AEC sector in Portugal. 

Participation is free of charge, but registration is mandatory 👉 here.

The agenda is as follows:

Opening Session

Sílvia Garcia | ANI; Rita Moura | Teixeira Duarte; João Poças Martins | BUILT CoLAB

Project Communication – PPS5 | Lurdes Laranjeira | BUILT CoLAB

DIGI4Construction Results – PPS1 | Francisco Reis | BIMMS

Digital Twin for AEC Results – PPS2 | João Vaz da Silva | 3Map

BREAK

Digital Twin for AEC Results – PPS3 | João Vaz da Silva | 3Maps

PAV 4.0 LC and BIM4Bridges Demonstrator Results – PPS4 | João Moutinho | BUILT CoLAB; Joel Oliveira | UMinho; Noel Leitão | TDGI

Debate: "The Importance of the Mobilising Project for Digitalisation in Construction"

Francisco Reis | BIMMS; Rita Moura | Teixeira Duarte; Luís Gomes | Mota-Engil; Sérgio Laranjeira | Grupo CASAIS; Laura Caldeira | LNEC – Moderated by João Moutinho | BUILT CoLAB

Closing | Manuel Maria Teixeira Duarte | Teixeira Duarte


Join us at this event!
